title: Second Minimum Node In a Binary Tree
goal: Find the second smallest distinct value in a tree whose parent equals the minimum of its children.
strategy: The root is the minimum. Explore below equal-valued nodes; once a larger candidate appears, descendants cannot improve it within that branch.
